agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report and ratified the audited Financial Statements, granting full discharge to the Board of Directors and Commissioners for the fiscal year.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved the allocation of Rp2.47 trillion in net profit, designating Rp1.98 trillion for cash dividends, Rp200 million for reserves, and the remainder for working capital.
Agenda #3: Purwanto Susanti dan Surja was appointed to audit the 2026 consolidated financial statements, with the Board of Commissioners authorized to determine fees.
Agenda #4: Shareholders approved the end of Suresh Vembu's term as Director and established the Board composition for the 2025-2030 term, including Soegiarto Adikoesoemo as President Commissioner.
Agenda #5: The meeting approved a maximum monthly honorarium of Rp420,000,000 for the Board of Commissioners and delegated the authority to set Directors' salaries to the Board.
Agenda #6: Shareholders approved amendments to the Articles of Association to align the company's business activities with the 2025 Indonesian Standard Industrial Classification (KBLI 2025).
Agenda #7: PT AKR Corporindo Tbk. filed official resumes for the Annual and Extraordinary General Meetings of Shareholders conducted in April 2026.
